d: Rookies Cameron Boozer and AJ Dybantsa put on a show as the Memphis Grizzlies defeated the Washington Wizards 136-120! Boozer led the way with an impressive 29 points, 7 rebounds, 7 assists and 7 three-pointers made, while Dybantsa finished with 21 points, 5 rebounds, 3 assists and 3 steals. Dybantsa also caught fire in the second quarter, recording a career quarter-high 12 points to help keep Washington competitive. Despite the strong rookie performances, Memphis came away with the victory, improving to 10-4 on the season as Washington dropped to 4-11.
